title: Use a segmented control to provide closely related choices that affect an object, state, or view

statement.en: Use a segmented control for closely related choices that affect an object, state, or view.
statement.ja: object、state、viewに影響する密接に関連したchoiceにはsegmented controlを使う。

conditions: An inspector can use one for one or more attributes.
A toolbar can use one for actions that affect the current view.
On macOS, a segmented control can support single choice, multiple choices, or momentary actions.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Segmented controls experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるSegmented controlsの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

conditions: The grouping persists across view sizes and placements.
The grouping can help people identify selected controls at a glance.

statement.ja: 1つのsegmented control内で各segmentのcontrol typeを統一する。
